apps.title: Monkey Obby: Master Escape
apps.summary:
Monkey Obby: Master Escape is a 3D parkour platformer for mobile. You control a character running across floating platforms and try to reach the end of each stage without falling.

How to play
Move with the on-screen joystick and tap the jump button to leap between platforms. Every step you take increases your running speed, so the later parts of a stage are faster and harder to control. If you fall, you respawn at your last checkpoint and keep going.

Features
- Multiple stages with increasing difficulty, each with its own layout of platforms, gaps and moving obstacles
- Speed system: your movement speed grows as you progress through a stage
- Level and experience system that tracks your progress
- Coins and trophies earned by clearing stages
- Upgrade menu to permanently improve speed, jump and other stats
- Shop with character skins and trail effects
- Checkpoint respawn, so you never restart a stage from the beginning

When your city becomes the hunting ground for ghosts and monsters... "Knock, knock." Someone's knocking on your door...

"Shh, don't make a sound, and don't open the door."

Creatures from age-old tales and urban legends are trying to break into your house. Your job? Close the door and defend it with your heroes as your heart pounds with excitement and no fear.

Schools, hospitals, hotels, streets, and office buildings—the most mundane locations become thrill-filled tower defense challenges. Get ready for stunning visuals and smooth controls in 5-minute matches!

apps.title: Pixel Gun 2
apps.summary:
Pixel Gun 2 is a multiplayer shooter built on disruption — of old rules, map architecture, traditional loadouts and more!

Short matches. Destructible arenas. Wild builds. Non-stop FPS action. Ever-evolving world. A piece of controlled mayhem that fits in your pocket — or takes over your evening. Jump in for a few PvP battles or lose track of time (with no regrets).

Experiment with loadouts, improvise in ever-changing environments, embrace the chaos, and make the most out of the reality-bending Pixelstorm!

EVERY MATCH HITS DIFFERENT
Change is the only constant in Pixel Gun 2. The battle arena starts falling apart with every shot fired. Creative builds clash, throwing surprises at everyone involved.

As the PvP match goes on, you evolve too — stacking perks, adapting on the fly, and leaning into whatever the situation demands. Will you end up a life-stealing headshot machine, a melee juggernaut, a speed-running gadgeteer — or something nobody saw coming?

Next time it will be different. And that’s the point.

WRECK HAVOC. MAKE A MESS
Pixel Gun 2 maps are breaking apart — and you’d better take advantage of it.

Use the destructible environment for smart tactical moves or just for the sake of pure fun. No cover is built to last. If something’s in your way — blow a hole through it. If someone’s camping — make a few “architectural adjustments” to their hiding spot.

You’re not here to build. You’re here to destroy. The battlefield keeps changing — and so do your options.

YOUR CHARACTER. YOUR BUILD. YOUR VIBE
Pixel Gun 2 is all about playing your way.

Mix characters, weapons, gadgets, armor, perks, and abilities into builds that feel powerful, clever, aggressive, weird — or all of the above.

Get creative. Break the meta. Find something that just clicks.

CROSS DIMENSIONS. MORE PLATFORMS AHEAD.
Start your journey on mobile, with Pixel Gun 2 coming to PC in the future. Cross-platform play and shared progression are planned, so your progress and rewards can travel with you between devices.
Play now — and stay tuned for PC release news.

THE PIXELSTORM IS RISING
The world of Pixel Gun 2 isn’t about order or stability — it’s about constant change and adaptation.

A strange calamity keeps bending the rules of reality, opening new possibilities (and dangers) over time. New heroes, gear, abilities, seasons, game modes, and even entire worlds appear in this ever-shifting multiverse.

Pixel Gun 2 is a mobile first-person shooter that evolves around — and for — you. Expect the unexpected.

apps.title: Word Connections Master
apps.summary:
🔍 What do some words have in common that others simply do not?

That question is at the heart of every puzzle in Word Connections Master, the word game that trains you to see what is hiding between the words.

Every level places a group of words in front of you. Some seem completely unrelated. But look closer, and a connection begins to emerge. A hidden category. An association that was there all along, waiting for you to notice it.

🧩 HOW THE GAME WORKS
This word association game gives you a group of words and one goal: group them by their hidden connection. Four words per category. Multiple categories per level. Each correct association locks in. Each wrong guess makes you look again. The game never rushes you. It simply waits, patiently, for the moment the connection clicks.

And when it does? That feeling is unlike any other word game.

🔎 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?
In this game, associations come from everywhere. Sometimes the connection is a shared category, such as colours, animals, or countries. Sometimes it is a concept like: words that all follow something, or precede something, or describe the same feeling. Sometimes the association is so unexpected that you will stop and smile when you find it.

That is the magic of this word game. The connections are always logical. They are just not always obvious.

💡 WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER
🔹Word associations you never knew existed
🔹Categories and connections that span language, culture, nature, and everyday life
🔹A new way of reading words, not just for meaning, but for the hidden relationship
🔹How much your vocabulary and general knowledge can surprise you
🔹That the most satisfying game moments come from connections you almost missed

🎯 WHAT THE GAME BUILDS
🔸Stronger word association skills with every puzzle you solve
🔸A richer vocabulary and deeper understanding of language
🔸Pattern recognition that sharpens the more you play
🔸A calmer, more curious way of approaching problems
🔸Confidence in finding connections where others see none

📦 WHAT IS INSIDE
🔹Hundreds of word association puzzles across dozens of unexpected themes
🔹A game that grows in depth the further you explore
🔹Progressive difficulty, early connections welcome you, later ones will make you wonder
🔹A gentle hint system that nudges without spoiling the association
🔹New word connections and game puzzles added regularly
🔹Clean, minimal design that keeps the focus on the words

🌟 A WORD GAME THAT ASKS MORE OF YOU
Most word games ask you to spell, or to guess, or to find. Word Connections Master asks you to understand — to see the relationship between words that, on the surface, share nothing at all.

It is a game about curiosity. About the pleasure of a pattern recognised. About the quiet thrill of a connection finally made. How many will you find?

Classic word games give you a wheel of letters — WoW Hexa gives you a hexagon board where only touching tiles connect. The same letters can hide many paths, and only the right ones spell the words you need.

Endless variety of boards
From compact honeycombs to sprawling hexagon grids, every chapter reshapes the board and resets the challenge. No two levels play the same.

Bonus words and rewards
Sharp eyes earn extra: discover hidden bonus words for coins, and use hints when a tricky crossword has you stuck.

Relax while you play
Serene landscapes, gentle animations, and no time pressure make WoW Hexa the perfect game to calm your mind while keeping it sharp.

Kanji Search turns time with kanji into a puzzle you'll actually want to play — think classic Word Search, but with kanji.

Love Japanese, or learning it? It's a relaxing way to meet real kanji every day — and a satisfying brain-teaser if you just love puzzles.

HOW IT PLAYS
Every board gives you a set of target kanji and a grid of components. Swipe to connect the right pieces and complete each kanji — easy to pick up, satisfying to master. As you find one, you see its meaning and watch it drawn stroke by stroke, so you absorb real Japanese while you play.

WRITE IT, DON'T JUST FIND IT
Learn to write kanji — not just recognize them. Tap any kanji you've found to open the practice pad and trace it stroke by stroke over a guide, in the correct order and direction. Draw a stroke right in one clean pass and it locks in; miss and it resets — so the shape really sticks. Going from finding a word to writing it is where kanji start to feel like yours.

A QUICK EXAMPLE
森 "forest" = 木 + 木 + 木 (three trees). 休 "rest" = 亻 (person) + 木 (tree). Every kanji breaks into pieces like these — find them on the grid.

• Real kanji with their meanings
• Stroke-by-stroke order for every kanji
• Spans JLPT levels, school grades, radicals and frequency

FOUR DIFFICULTIES

apps.title: Backcourt: Basketball Manager
apps.summary:
You are not on the bench. You are running the club.

Backcourt is a basketball management game. You found your own club — the city, the name, the kit colours and the opening budget are yours. Everything after that is on you: build the roster, live under the cap, put the right five on the floor and chase a title in a twenty-club league.

A POOL BUILT ON REAL DATA
364 players. Positions, ages, annual salaries and the balance of power are derived from real 2025-26 season data; the players carry FICTIONAL names. Overall rating rewards genuine impact, not the role player who pads a box score.

LIVE MATCHES
Games play out live on the floor. You call the timeout, you make the substitution, you change the scheme mid-game. The last minutes are their own game: intentional fouling, a set play out of the final timeout, and foul-trouble protection. In a hurry? Skip to the result — but if the game is tight, Backcourt offers to let you play the finish.

ROSTER MANAGEMENT
Every player carries energy. Minutes burn it; age and your facilities decide how fast it comes back. Hand out minutes yourself, rest a tired player for a week, lock in your starting five. If a player is a poor fit for his role, the squad screen tells you.

TRANSFERS AND TRADES
A transfer market, free agents, a league-wide player search and a trade table. Swap players and draft picks, balance the salaries, then sit down at the contract table and argue over money and years. At season's end, one window handles every expiring deal.

SCOUTING, DRAFT AND DEVELOPMENT
A prospect's potential is not a number, it is a range — buy a scouting report and it narrows. You set the weekly training focus and run individual drills as mini-games. The academy intake turns up gems and wonderkids; draft night brings the lottery, your picks and a full prospect board.

RUNNING THE BUSINESS
Build and upgrade six facilities: gym, medical staff, academy, arena, analytics and recovery. Each has a build time and a weekly running cost. The board, the fans and the locker room watch you separately — a bad report card puts your seat under heat. Let the balance fall past the limit and you cannot take the floor until you sell.

TWENTY-ONE SEASONS
A career that runs from 2026 to 2046. Awards night, an all-league five, a career ledger and prestige. Three save slots, autosave and an offline mode — you can play without an account.

ONLINE LEAGUE
Face real managers. Twenty coaches enter a lobby, a draft deals the rosters and a round plays every 12 hours. Submit your tactics and starting five before tip-off, send your scout out for a report on the next rival, train players around the clock and strike trades that survive league review. A club newspaper prints after every round — blowouts get the mocking headline they deserve — and the market, facilities and playoffs run across multiple seasons up to the hall of honor.

Eight languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Filipino.
Free to play, no in-app purchases. The app shows a few ads at natural breaks — never during a match; rewarded ads are always optional.

apps.title: Last Shelter: War Z
apps.summary:
The last bastion of humanity has fallen. As the Commander of a final group of survivors, you face a grim new world in the aftermath of doomsday. You hid in an abandoned underground shelter. You must venture into the unknown, reclaim the wasteland, and eradicate the zombie horde. Build your underground stronghold, but remember: survival demands more than walls—it requires expansion, exploration, and relentless combat.​

【BUILD YOUR SURVIVAL SHELTER】
Your underground fortress is the heart of your resistance. Build and customize every room—from Power Generators and Research Labs to Control Centers. Upgrade your facilities to unlock advanced weapons. Design your layout with tactical strategy, because this isn't just a home, it's a war base that fuels your fight to reclaim the world.

【EXPLORE & COLLECT UNDERGROUND】
The real adventure lies in the darkness. Send elite squads into unexplored tunnels and the desolate wastelands shown on your map. Scavenge for vital resources, uncover lost technology, and undertake critical missions to rescue other survivors and search for a cure​ under the zombie horde. Every expedition is a high-stakes mission: stay vigilant—zombies lurk everywhere, and danger strikes without warning.

【FIGHT ZOMBIES】
Combat is brutal and constant. Face off against zombie swarms, terrifying mutant bosses, and other enemy threats lurking in the shadows. Assemble a team of unique heroes, master their powerful abilities, and devise tactical formations to crush your enemies in intense battle. Engage in clashes where you must shoot, fight with guns, and survive enemy fire.

【BASE DEFENSE & TOWER TACTICS】
Your shelter is a prize coveted by all. Defend it from waves of zombies and raids from rival commanders! Construct defensive fortifications, lay cunning traps, and strategically place guard towers to create an impenetrable fortress. Use your radar to detect incoming enemy​ hordes and plan your strategy.

Forge powerful alliances with other players to conquer the wasteland together. Coordinate attacks, share resources, and participate in large-scale alliance wars to dominate the ruined cityscapes. Victory in this endless war belongs to those who unite.

Last Shelter: War Z offers a rich, strategic survival experience with a focus on exploration, combat, and cooperation. The apocalypse was the end of the world, but this is the start of yours. Will you lead humanity to rebirth? Download now and begin your underground odyssey!

apps.summary:
🚚 Highway Heroes is the truck tycoon management game where strategy beats speed. Build a freight company from the ground up, plan smart routes across U.S. regions, and grow your idle tycoon empire through careful decisions — not quick reflexes. If you love a logistics game that rewards patience and planning, welcome home.

🗺️ Start with one garage and a single rig in this truck tycoon adventure. Line up hauling contracts, choose the best routes for profit and efficiency, and deliver on time to build your reputation. Every dollar earned is a decision made — reinvest in your fleet, expand your facilities, or unlock new regions. With idle tycoon earnings working for you around the clock, your company never stops growing.

🏗️ Build the infrastructure behind your logistics game empire. Add garages, service bays, and dispatch offices that directly improve turnaround time, driver reliability, and contract access. Every upgrade in this management game reshapes how your business operates — faster maintenance, smarter logistics, and bigger contracts within reach.

🎨 Customize your fleet down to the details in this truck tycoon. Choose authentic paint schemes, decals, lighting rigs, trailers, and performance parts. Clean isometric views and tidy menus make every choice easy to read and satisfying to make — even on smaller screens. The idle tycoon system lets your customized trucks earn while you plan your next move.

📦 Master the logistics game at the heart of Highway Heroes. Match the right loads to the right trucks, schedule around weather and distance, and keep fuel costs and repairs under control. Managing contracts in this truck tycoon feels like running a real business: orderly, fair, and deeply satisfying.

🛻 Collect iconic American haulers in this management game. From classic rigs to modern workhorses, each truck unlocks new routes and contract types. This is a logistics game where your collection has real strategic value — not just cosmetic appeal. Every truck you add strengthens your fleet with new cargo options and better efficiency across regions.

👀 See everything at a glance. Crisp isometric angles, clear icons, and legible text make complex decisions feel simple. The idle tycoon mechanics keep your company running smoothly, so you can check in on your terms.

apps.title: Transport Tycoon Empire 2
apps.summary:
Build your transport empire and shape history.

Welcome to Transport Tycoon Empire 2, a rich and immersive transport tycoon game where you take on the role of a transport manager. Start with a struggling logistics company in 1930s America and rise to become a global leader in transportation.

Take control of trains, ships, planes, and trucks as you create efficient transport lines between cities, mines, factories, and ports. Deliver passengers and a wide variety of cargo, upgrade your fleet, and optimize every route for speed and profit. Prove yourself as a skilled logistics manager on your journey from humble beginnings to industrial dominance.

📦 Think Like a Logistics manager
Design complex transport networks, connect supply chains, and balance production and demand. Every decision you make as a manager will shape the economy of entire regions.

🚂 Trains, Planes, Ships & Trucks
Manage four classes of vehicles: rail, air, water, and road—each with unique stats and upgrade paths. As a fleet manager, you’ll need to optimize for distance, capacity, and cargo type.

🌍 Historic Eras & Real-World Challenges
Advance through decades, from the Great Depression to the Cold War and beyond. Each era introduces new technologies, events, and gameplay twists. Face fuel shortages, wars, and environmental crises as you expand your empire.

🏙️ Main City Growth
Develop your main city—the heart of your empire. Upgrading it unlocks new routes, boosts production, and generates more passengers.

🔧 Upgradeable Everything
Enhance vehicles, stations, factories, and more. Tailor your strategy to meet changing demands and unlock rare contracts.

🌐 Cross-Regional Progression
Complete contracts, earn XP, and unlock new regions. Each region offers new biomes, challenges, and a fresh start to test your skills again.

🎯 Perfect for Fans of Strategy & Simulation
Transport Tycoon Empire 2 combines deep systems design with accessible gameplay. Whether you’re a transport enthusiast, strategy lover, or aspiring transport manager, you’ll find endless satisfaction in optimizing your routes and growing your empire.

apps.title: All-Timers: 17-0 & 82-0 Draft
apps.summary:
Chase the perfect season: go 17-0 in the NFL or 82-0 in the NBA. One loss and the undefeated season is over.

Two sports, one run, and the regular season is just the start.

All Timers is a sports draft game for football and basketball fans. Spin to draw a franchise and a decade, draft one all-time player per round, and build an all-time roster from scratch. Then run your season and find out how far your draft can carry you.

DRAFT AN ALL-TIME ROSTER
Every spin deals you a franchise and an era. You pick the legend. Seven rounds, one all-time team, no two drafts the same.

GO UNDEFEATED, THEN GO FURTHER
Win out and you finish the regular season undefeated. Most draft games stop there. All-Timers keeps going: earn a playoff berth, enter the gauntlet, and chase a flawless run to a perfect 20-0 in football or an undefeated title run in basketball. The further you push, the higher your Season Score.

TWO SPORTS, ONE APP
Football and basketball live in one app on one account. Draft an all-time football roster, an all-time basketball roster, or both. No second download.

A SKILL SCORE, NOT JUST LUCK
Draft Average rates every run from .000 to 1.000 based on how close you came to the perfect draft. Server-verified scores keep the leaderboard honest, so the best drafters rise on merit.

MODES
- Free Play: draft, run a full season, chase the playoff gauntlet, and beat your best Season Score.
- Daily Challenge: everyone drafts from the same daily deal. One shot, ranked against the world.
- Play With Friends: send a challenge, draft head to head, and settle who is the better GM.

SHARE YOUR RUN
Every season makes a share card worth posting: your record, your Season Score, your Draft Average, your all-time roster.

Free to play, no account required. Sign in to save your seasons, climb the daily and all-time leaderboards, and challenge your friends.

All-Timers is an independent game. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or licensed by any professional sports league, team, or organization. Player references use names and statistics only.

apps.title: AI Dungeon Master & RPG Fablia
apps.summary:
Fablia is an AI Dungeon Master that runs a fantasy RPG built around you. No group to schedule, no rulebook to memorise, no waiting for anyone else. Describe what your hero does, and the AI narrates what happens next.

A DUNGEON MASTER THAT NEVER RUNS OUT OF STORY
Type any action and the AI Dungeon Master answers it. Talk your way past the gate guards, torch the tavern, spare the bandit who begged, or walk away from the whole quest. The story bends around your choice and remembers what you did. No two runs tell the same tale, because nothing is scripted.

THREE WAYS TO BEGIN YOUR QUEST
• Quick Start — drop into an adventure in seconds
• Forge — a guided RPG character creator. Choose your age and origin, take the skills your past earned you, then spend your stat points
• Sandbox — no rules, no rails. Write your own world, set its laws, seed the people who matter, and tell the Dungeon Master exactly how to run it

ROLL THE DICE AND LIVE WITH IT
Skill checks are settled the tabletop way, with a real D20 roll rendered in 3D with sound and haptics. Beat the target and you stay on your feet. Miss it and fortune turns against you. Push your luck too far and you are rolling a death save.

YOUR HERO, YOUR RECORD
• Character sheet tracking stats, skills and gear
• Codex that fills in with the lore, people and places you uncover
• Chronicle of every scene in your campaign
• Multiple save slots, so several adventures can run side by side

BE ANYONE, WITH NO LIMITS
Play the knight who keeps their oath or the one who breaks it. Be a scheming merchant, a hedge witch, a deserter, a god-touched fool. The AI roleplay adapts to the character you actually write, not a class you picked from a list.

WHY PLAYERS PICK FABLIA
• A solo RPG you can play in five minutes or five hours
• Interactive fiction with real consequences, not a branching menu
• A text adventure where you type freely instead of tapping preset replies
• A choose your own adventure engine that never repeats itself
• Tabletop-style dungeon crawling without needing a party

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Explore ruined keeps and drowned shrines. Bargain, bluff and threaten your way through encounters. Recruit companions and lose them. Build a hero from nothing and watch the world start reacting to your name. Or throw all of it out and build a world of your own in Sandbox, down to how the Dungeon Master should narrate it.

Fablia is for anyone who loves fantasy RPG storytelling, interactive story games, AI roleplay, dungeon master simulators, text adventures and classic tabletop roleplaying, but wants it available the moment the mood strikes.

Your world is unwritten. Begin your quest.

The first official hololive mobile game『hololive Dreams (holodori)』 is here, featuring a rhythm & RPG gameplay!
Centered around rhythm games, the game includes a variety of content such as theme park development and mini-games!
Over 50 hololive members make an appearance, and the initial tracklist will include 150+ songs!
A game that both hololive fans and newcomers can enjoy. The way you play is entirely up to you!

▼A full-fledged rhythm game▼
Enjoy a genuine rhythm game based on official music videos and live concert videos!

The game features an ""Original Chart"" function, allowing you to make and share your own original charts!
・Extremely challenging, hardcore charts for dedicated players!
・Charts filled with love for the talents!
・Fun and quirky charts that everyone can enjoy together!
And more! You are the limit!
Play with charts created by players from all around the world, and experience endless fun!

Even if you're not good at rhythm games, you can enjoy it worry-free with the auto-play feature!
Aim for higher scores by training and organizing your talents!

▼A wide variety of over 150 songs at launch!▼
From hololive songs to cover songs!
The lineup includes everything from the latest hits to classic tracks!

hololive songs
・BIBBIDIBA
・Shiny Smily Story
・BLUE CLAPPER
And more!

Cover songs
・The Brave
・Megitsune
・Watashi no Ichiban Kawaiitokoro
And more!

▼The game is set in a theme park▼
hololive members have arrived to an uninhabited island floating somewhere in the world.
And you will need to team up with them to develop your very own dream theme park!

Play rhythm games and mini-games to complete quests and expand your theme park!
Also, by completing holomem Quests, you can unlock and add more playable talents!
Unlock your favorite holomem and build your dream theme park!
Many facilities full of hololive’s unique charm will also take the stage!
Experience an original story unique to this game!

Aim to complete your dream theme park!

▼Mini-games. Solo or with everyone!▼
The game will include a variety of mini-games that can be enjoyed alone or with friends!
Have fun with everyone or compete against others!

Includes mini-games with simple controls, so even those who struggle with tricky actions can enjoy them!
A wide lineup ranging from casual games you can play in a short time, to challenging, hardcore games you'll want to keep replaying!

Earn rewards by playing, and use them to speed up the talent’s growth and theme park development!


▼Official website: https://www.hololive-dreams.com/en

apps.title: Chimera TCG
apps.summary:
Real animals. Strange splices. Stranger battles.

Chimera TCG is a strategic collectible card game where you splice real animals into creatures that have never existed, collect them, and build a deck for battle.

COLLECT THE ANIMAL KINGDOM

Start with 54 real animal Base cards, each with nature-documentary field notes, an environment, a size, and a trait. Great White Shark. Golden Eagle. Honey Badger. The building blocks of a much stranger collection.

SPLICE SOMETHING NEW

Combine two Base cards in the Splicer to create a Chimera. Every pairing is valid. Compatible animals are easier to Splice, while unlikely combinations can produce rarer results at greater risk.

Add a third Base card to attempt a Mythic Chimera. Use Stabilizers to improve your odds, or stack three Stabilizers for a guaranteed success.

DISCOVER WHAT NO ONE HAS

When someone successfully Splices a brand-new combination, its name, artwork, and field notes are created on the spot. Discover it first and you are credited in the shared catalog as its Origin Splicer.

BATTLE ACROSS THREE LANES

Build a 12-card deck and battle across Land, Water, and Air in a six-turn match. Spend energy to play cards face-down, then watch both sides reveal simultaneously. Win two of the three lanes to take the match.

Build around card abilities, trait interactions, and home-lane advantages. Fight adaptive rivals, climb from Novice toward Master, compete on the weekly wins leaderboard, or challenge friends in live head-to-head battles.

GROW YOUR COLLECTION

Earn XP by battling, Splicing, and opening packs. Spend Coins to level up your favorite cards, and Recycle spare duplicates into more Coins.

Send Field Expeditions that return with free cards. Complete daily quests, progress through a new Battle Pass each month, and earn rewards as your collection grows.

CHASE VARIANTS AND COMPLETE LINEAGES

Collect special Variants with alternate artwork and Battle bonuses, including limited-time seasonal styles such as Steampunk. Complete animal Lineages to earn Silver and Gold Leaf Variants, fill your Trophy Case, and unlock collection rewards.

FREE TO PLAY

Build your collection, Splice Chimeras, and battle without spending money. Optional in-app purchases are available. An internet connection is required.

In-app purchases and randomized items: Some optional card packs contain randomized cards. Exact odds and selection rules are shown in the app before purchase and at chimeratcg.app/odds.html. Catalog-based odds may change as players discover new Chimeras. Gems cannot be exchanged for real money.

apps.title: Gugu Gaga: Keyboard Escape
apps.summary:
Gugu is an exhilarating and action-packed survival obby game where speed, timing, and precision are the keys to staying alive. A massive tsunami is approaching, and only your quick reflexes can help you conquer the deadly obby courses and escape the rising waves.

In this endless parkour runner and escape adventure, you control your character as they run through dangerous paths filled with challenging obstacles, intricate traps, and unexpected jumps. The tsunami is always behind you, creating nonstop tension and thrill. One wrong move can end the run, so stay alert and keep moving forward.

This game combines classic obby gameplay, escape mechanics, and survival challenges to deliver an addictive experience for players of all ages. Easy to play but hard to master, Gugu Gaga Penguin: Obby Escape keeps you engaged with fast-paced gameplay, smooth controls, and increasing difficulty.

Game Features:
- Fast-paced tsunami escape survival gameplay
- Simple one-touch controls for smooth running and jumping
- Challenging obby obstacles and dynamic parkour environments
- Endless runner style with increasing speed and difficulty
- Lightweight and optimized for all Android devices
- Fun and addictive gameplay for kids and adults

As you progress, the game becomes more intense. The tsunami moves faster, obstacles appear more frequently, and your reaction time is tested to the limit. Compete with yourself to beat your high score and see how long you can survive the unstoppable wave.

If you enjoy escape games, running games, survival games, or endless parkour adventures, this game is perfect for you. Gugu Gaga Penguin: Keyboard Escape delivers nonstop excitement and tension.

apps.title: Basketball Career Sim 2026
apps.summary:
A deep basketball career sim that plays fully offline — no accounts, no energy timers, no waiting. Just you, 82 games a season, and a legacy to build.
You're a rookie nobody believes in yet. Pick your archetype, sign with a team, and find out what kind of player you become — franchise legend, roleplayer, or a bench warmer.

⛹️ BUILD A PLAYER THAT FEELS LIKE YOURS
Go small and quick or tall and physical — your height and weight reshape your ceiling. Choose from authentic archetypes like Slasher, Sharpshooter, Playmaker, Lockdown and Stretch Big, then tune 16 attributes to match how you would play.

🏀 EVERY GAME COUNTS
A full 82-game season with live standings that react to every result. Ball out in the first half and crack the All-Star roster. Carry your team through a 4-round playoff bracket built for upsets — and if you bring home the ring, the Finals MVP might have your name on it.

📈 TRAIN HARD. BUT NOT TOO HARD.
Spend training points after every game — Normal, Intense, or full Mamba mode. Your archetype's signature skills level up twice as fast. But push Mamba intensity too many nights in a row and your numbers will crater when it matters most. Energy is a resource. Manage it like a pro.

💰 GET PAID. GET FAMOUS.
Your stock rises, endorsement deals follow. Buy estates, watch your net worth climb with every contract — and build a following on Chirper, the in-game social feed that reacts to your actual performance. Drop 40 and watch the mentions blow up. Brick the game-winner and hear about it.

🏆 RETIRE A LEGEND — OR DON'T
MVP. DPOY. All-PRO. 60+ achievements, season awards, and a career résumé that rolls forward year after year. When you finally hang it up, your Hall of Fame case is whatever you made it.

OFFLINE FIRST, PLAYER FIRST
Hoop Life plays fully offline. No accounts. No waiting on timers. Your save lives on your device, and your career is yours alone.

apps.title: Lordrush
apps.summary:
Lordrush is a medieval tower defense strategy game where you rebuild a ruined fortress and defend your realm from attacks.

Gather resources, raise defenses, upgrade towers, and recruit heroes as you prepare for each assault.

Set in a harsh medieval world of stone castles, armored heroes, war-torn battlefields, and rival lords, Lordrush blends fortress building, resource management, hero strategy, and tactical defense.

Wood, stone, and iron are essential for expansion. Compete with exiles, rebels, and other forces for control of vital resources.

Construct defensive walls to slow enemy advances and give your towers more time to strike.

Start from a single fortress, build your defenses, gather resources, expand your power, and become a lord who cannot be ignored.

Ready for a game that relaxes you and fires up your brain at the same time? Welcome to Connect Tracks — a logic puzzle game built around the classic train tracks puzzle.
Here you have just one job: lay a single, fully connected railway and put every stretch of track exactly where it belongs!

Number clues: Every row and column has a number beside it, telling you exactly how many track cells belong there. Count them — the answer is hidden in the numbers.

From 4×4 starter boards to brain-bending 12×12 grids, the difficulty climbs steadily, and every level has a unique solution.

345 is a daily word puzzle where you organize text fragments into words. Your goal is to identify the solution words, which are hidden in a square grid of text fragment tiles.

Each day you will find 3 new daily puzzles: 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5, that offer challenges of increasing difficulty to fit into your daily puzzle schedule.

3x3 -> A simple warm-up puzzle with 9 tiles that asks you to find 3 solution words, each solution using 3 tiles.
4x4 -> A satisfying challenge with 16 fragments and 4 solution words, each solution requiring 4 tiles.
5x5 -> A difficult brainteaser with 25 tiles and 5 solution words, each solution requiring 5 tiles.

On your way to the solution, you may always submit shorter, non-solution words, which unlocks precious information about how those tiles fit into their solutions.

Build the Ultimate Racing Dynasty!

Take the wheel and become the ultimate team boss in Race Star! Sign legendary drivers, tune your machines, and build a championship-winning garage across six high-octane racing classes. Whether you are screaming down the straightaway in an open-wheel rocket or crushing the competition in a monster truck, your strategic calls are the only thing standing between your team and racing glory.

As the team owner you control every part of the operation. Scout fresh talent, train raw rookies into world-class champions, and set your lineup for race day. Best of all? The engines never stop. Watch your race plan play out in thrilling automated race simulations and keep banking idle cash even while you are away!

6 RACING DISCIPLINES IN 1 GAME
Why master just one kind of racing? Build unstoppable teams across Open-Wheel Racing, Stock Cars, Rally, Superbikes, Speedsters, and Monster Trucks. Every discipline brings its own drivers, machines, and tracks to conquer.

COLLECT, TRAIN & MERGE DRIVERS
Pull new drivers into your collection and pour your idle profits into training them and maxing out their stats. Merge duplicate drivers to power them up, unlock deep skill trees, and find the perfect driver synergy to outpace the field. Your team keeps grinding and winning in the background, so you always come back to massive idle rewards.

COLLECT & UPGRADE CARS IN THE GARAGE
Step into the all-new Garage and build a stable of powerful cars! Collect new vehicles, make each one stronger with Vehicle Parts, and customize them with unique colors and decals. Tune your rides to go even faster and hit the track in a style that is all yours.

CLIMB THE CHAMPIONSHIP LEAGUES
Start at the back of the grid and finish the season on top to promote into higher, tougher leagues. Every podium pushes your team up the ranks. Earn trophies, chase the title, and cement your legacy as the greatest garage in the world.

RISE THROUGH CAREER MODE
Create your own career driver and train them from rookie to superstar. Spend skill points across a deep skill tree, specialize for any racing class, and respec any time to chase the perfect build.

JOIN A CLUB & BATTLE IN CLUB CLASH
Team up with racers around the world in a Club. Go head to head with rival clubs in Club Clash, capture ranked positions in best-of-three showdowns, rack up Club Points, and share huge team rewards.

COLLECT CARDS IN SEASONAL COLLECTIONS
Open packs, fill themed albums, and complete Collections for exclusive prizes. Turn duplicate cards into Stars, spend them in the Star Shop, and finish every album in a season to unlock the ultimate reward.

RACE BREAKER LIVE EVENTS
Jump into Race Breaker, a limited-time event with its own unique races. Climb the event leaderboard, stack up Rush Gems, and power through the Race Pass for stacks of exclusive rewards before the clock runs out.

UPGRADE ELITE GEAR
Kit out your drivers with powerful racing gear after every win. Collect gear shards and coupons to unlock rare equipment and level up every piece for the ultimate edge on the track.

UNLOCK THE SEASON PASS & OFFERS
Climb the Season Pass, chase rotating driver banners, and grab limited-time deals that keep every season fresh. There is always a new reward to race for.

Do you have what it takes to build an unstoppable idle racing dynasty? Download Race Star now and start your first season!

Create weird and wonderful recipes for guests in this open-ended cooking game for kids. Spaghetti smoothie? Deep-fried watermelon? Go ahead, try it!

"Toca Boca Jr Kitchen" invites all young chefs to get messy and start playing. With three guests to cook for, a kitchen full of different tools to use and countless food combinations to test out, the possibilities are infinite.

GET CREATIVE IN THE KITCHEN
Who said meals have to look good — or taste good? In "Toca Boca Jr Kitchen," you can cook however you want! Boil a salad, juice a shrimp or fry up a pineapple. Come up with your very own recipes and treat your guests to something special.

GO AHEAD, MAKE A MESS
With five different kitchen tools to choose from, you can explore all kinds of food experiments. Will you chop and sauté, or just load everything into the juicer? Prep your favorite ingredients, get messy and finish off with a pinch of something unexpected.

WATCH THEIR REACTIONS
Time to let your guest have a bite! Is it a winner? Discover your guests' preferences by seeing how they react. Oven-baked fish head with fried leftovers and lettuce juice coming right up! Oh, they didn't like it? Try adding some salt. It's fun to get the "ew"!

FEATURES:
• Three characters to feed, each with their own likes and dislikes
• A fridge full of fun ingredients, from oranges to octopus
• Five kitchen tools to cook with, including a juicer and oven
• No rules or stress — just open-ended, kid-directed fun
• No third-party advertising

ABOUT TOCA BOCA
We believe in the power of play to spark kids' imaginations and help them learn about the world. We design our products from the kids' perspective to empower kids to be playful, to be creative and to be who they want to be. Our products include award-winning apps that have been downloaded more than 200 million times in 215 countries and offer fun, open-ended play experiences.

- Created by Toca Boca.
